description: This course covers foundational and advanced topics in software testing and quality assurance, including test case design techniques like equivalence partitioning, boundary value analysis, and state transition testing; testing methodologies such as Agile and DevOps practices; automation tools like Selenium and JUnit; static analysis tools like SonarQube; and standards such as IEEE 829 and ISO 9001. Students will explore test management frameworks, defect tracking systems, and performance testing with JMeter. The course emphasizes practical application of testing principles, including test automation scripts, continuous integration pipelines, and quality assurance in cloud-based systems.

clos.text: Define test case design techniques such as equivalence partitioning, boundary value analysis, and state transition testing.
Describe Agile and DevOps testing methodologies and their integration with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
Explain the principles of static code analysis and dynamic testing using tools like SonarQube and JUnit.
Apply test automation frameworks such as Selenium and JMeter to develop and execute automated test scripts.
Evaluate the effectiveness of quality assurance practices in cloud-based and distributed systems using ISO 9001 and IEEE 829 standards.
